Accuracy on article questions

The Article Scroll

a / an — one of many, first mention. Use an before a vowel sound.
a dragon · an onion · an hour · a useful map
the — we both know which; unique things; superlatives; rivers & seas.
the sun · the best potion · close the door · the river
— (no article) — general plurals & uncountables, meals, languages, sports, go to bed, last week.
Dragons fly · have breakfast · speak English · play football
watch out! play the guitar but play — football; go to — bed but open the door.
